sentences: A graph stream reveals edges in sequence while the algorithm keeps a small memory state.
The task is to approximate the shortest-path distance between specified vertices.
The source asks whether multiple passes or random edge order permit better approximations than approaches based on preserving many distances in a spanner.
Following reachability one layer per pass computes the exact distance, but can require too many scans for distant vertices.
The project is to exploit the single-pair objective or additional passes without storing a large global distance-preserving graph.
